version_policy: automatic audit never increments BEST number

findings.result: Issue #7 combined the canonical BEST56 app gate and historical BEST40 gate into one queue task, unnecessarily blocking P0 #11 runtime migration until BEST40 was also available.
Queue was partitioned into P0-7A-CANONICAL-APP and P0-7B-FROZEN-BEST40. P0 #11 and THIRD_UI now depend only on canonical app, while BEST40 remains an independent release gate.
P0-7A-CANONICAL-APP remains the highest-priority READY task for PRIMARY; exact BEST56 SHA-256 remains mandatory.

p0_p1.source_of_truth_update: Issue #7 release work is now represented as two queue subtasks. Runtime migration #11 is blocked only by canonical app 7A, not historical BEST40 7B.

impact.baza_mieszkan: No application behavior change. After canonical app is staged, data-integrity audit #11 and UI audit can proceed without waiting for historical BEST40.
impact.data_integrity: Reduces unnecessary blocking of the schema 11->12 runtime verification while preserving BEST40 as a separate release gate.
impact.automation: Dependency graph now matches actual technical prerequisites and enables earlier parallel audit work.
